_note:
Re-derived 2026-09-01 after bloodline merged as v1.1.0. TWO TARGETS WERE DELETED RATHER THAN REPAIRED: 'a payoff that fires when a token is CREATED' and 'THE GO-WIDE KILL' had every card cut, because bloodline's whole thesis is that this is NOT A SWARM DECK — 400 Forge games, composite 31/400 against the champion's 50/400, interval excluding zero, and the mechanism was combat damage falling 29.07 to 18.20 because 1/1 tokens do not connect. Backfilling those groups would have declared a plan the deck deliberately abandoned. ADDED: a free-sacrifice-outlet target, which is the component bloodline actually brought and which nothing described — the goldfish's sac cap started firing (0.0 -> 0.003) on a component the declaration could not see.

Re-derived 2026-08-24, twice in one day, and the second pass is the one that matters. FIRST: every checker-passed proof of THE GO-WIDE KILL opens by CASTING a two-mana Vampire to fire eminence and no group named that leg, so `validate-goldfish-targets` had been reporting Gifted Aetherborn in three passing stacks and no component. The leg is the thirteen Vampire creatures at mana value <=2 — the class castable alongside the rest of the plan rather than instead of it — added both as its own group and as a third `need` on the kill. It is not free: 13 of 99 is 84.8% by turn six.

SECOND: the payoff leg was wrong in BOTH directions and three agents found it independently. It counted Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant, which trigger on a creature DYING and cannot fire on the entry event stack 009 kills from; and it omitted MIRKWOOD BATS, which arrived with the v1.0.0 paper list and sits in no component at all. Bats keys on CREATION ('whenever you create or sacrifice a token') rather than on 'enters', which is why both the declaration and a first oracle sweep missed it. So the group is split by trigger EVENT rather than relabelled: six creation-keyed payoffs are the kill's leg, and the two death drains keep a component of their own — they are a REACHABLE line, not a dead one, because Skullclamp kills a 1/1 token for {1} and Indulgent Aristocrat's sac outlet carries no tap symbol. That correction came from `engine-critic`, against an earlier draft of this note that claimed the deck could not manufacture the death.

Stack 011 (checker-passed) prices Bats: it triggers ONCE PER TOKEN, not once per creation event, so the count tracks tokens in the final modified event and never the number of doublers. It also settles that Vampire Socialite's counter does NOT apply to the tokens whose creation caused the first life loss of the turn — the ability has only triggered when they enter — while the Vampire spell itself, resolving later, does get it.

Cathars' Crusade is still deliberately NOT a token multiplier: it puts counters on creatures, it does not create tokens. Forerunner of the Legion is still NOT in the infinite's group: it TUTORS to the top rather than drawing, and this file models no tutors anywhere. Stack 009 verified the payoff group composing — nine triggers, 12 damage per opponent off one two-mana Vampire through a single doubler.

A CAVEAT ON THE CREATION LEG'S LABEL, raised by the tutor guide against this file and recorded here rather than only downstream. The label says 'fires when a token is CREATED', and five of its six members actually key on a CREATURE ENTERING (Purphoros, Impact Tremors, Warleader's Call, Corpse Knight, Witty Roastmaster); only Mirkwood Bats keys on creation. Inside this target's scope the two coincide — every checker-passed kill proof is about creature tokens from eminence, and a created creature token enters at the moment it is created — which is why the membership is right and the measured rate is right. It comes apart OUTSIDE that scope, in both directions: on a NONCREATURE token (Voldaren Epicure's Blood token) Bats fires and the other five do not; on a SACRIFICED token Bats fires alone; and on the non-token Vampire spell itself the five fire and Bats does not. Do not read the label as a claim about any of those cases. The label is kept as written because `closes` fields in diagnosis.json and engine.json resolve against it by string, and renaming it would mean hand-editing agent output to keep a reference alive — which this repo forbids for a better reason than this one is worth.

SHARED-LEG CORRECTION, 2026-08-24, found by ur-dragon's deck-engineer on a fleet scan and confirmed on 2 of 9 decks. Charismatic Conqueror sat in BOTH the multiplier leg and the castable-Vampire leg of THE GO-WIDE KILL, and `_target_met` marks a need met if any named card is in hand — so one drawn card satisfied two of the kill's three needs and the target reported a rate it had not earned. It is removed from the CASTABLE leg and kept in the MULTIPLIER leg, because a card should be counted where its job is scarcer: seven multipliers against thirteen castable Vampires. Measured cost of the correction: assembled 0.445 -> 0.433, by turn six 0.285 -> 0.269, mean turn 5.04 -> 5.20. Small here precisely because the castable leg is thirteen cards deep; on ur-dragon the same defect was worth 5.8 points. REPAIRED 2026-09-16 after the v-merge: cut cards removed from every group (Immersturm Predator, Unbounded Potential).
_model_drain_note: Turned on 2026-10-01, deliberately, as the re-baseline the drain-v1 branch needs: the pilot's 2026-09-29 direction (log 006) is life gain / life DRAIN as the engine, and with this flag OFF model-coverage read eleven of the deck's drain cards as DARK — Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant, Vito, Sanguine Bond, Bloodletter and the rest contributed exactly nothing to any goldfish figure, so a branch aimed at drain could not be read on the goldfish at all. A branch may NOT declare a channel its deck does not (the two-simulators rule), so the flag goes on the DECK and the deck's own tracked goldfish, diagnostic, benchmark and info are regenerated in the same commit. This is a per-deck flag, not a change to goldfish.py: meta.model_version does not move and no other deck's figures change. The Forge endpoint forge.drain_dealt remains the branch's primary; the goldfish drain rows are the cheap read beside it.
_model_sacrifice_note: Turned on 2026-08-28. Twenty of this deck's ninety-nine cards touch the sacrifice/death axis - Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Cruel Celebrant, Bastion of Remembrance, Viscera Seer, Ashnod's Altar, Woe Strider - and before this flag every one of them contributed exactly zero, because nothing died in the model. THE POLICY IS A CHOICE AND IT IS STATED: after combat has swung, creature TOKENS are converted to a free outlet while any death payoff is in play; nontoken creatures never are. A run without the flag is the floor and a run with it is the ceiling, and this deck's real value sits between them. It arrived alongside the fix for the commander's EMINENCE, which mints a 1/1 Vampire on every other Vampire cast and was not modelled at all - without those tokens the sacrifice engine had almost nothing to eat and read 0.26 conversions by turn ten.
_model_draw_note: Turned on 2026-08-28 alongside model_combat. The deck's most-repeated table failure is 'vampires on board, nothing in hand, no way to rebuild', and the model was structurally incapable of seeing it: card_advantage reported {cards_that_draw: 12, modelled: 0}. Under the flag, exactly ONE of those twelve (Night's Whisper) is an unconditional modelled draw; the other eleven are activated, X-based or conditional and are named in meta.card_advantage.draw_not_modelled. That ratio is the finding, not a defect in the parser. Opt-in for the same reason the other two flags are: drawing cards moves land drops, bodies and every assembly rate, so a deck adopts it when it is re-baselined deliberately.
_model_combat_note: Turned on 2026-08-28, deliberately, at the pilot's instruction and as the precondition for the `drain-engine` branch being falsifiable at all. Without it `diagnostic.output` reports `available: false` and the only objective axes this deck can be aimed at are `stall` and `land_drop` -- neither of which speaks to a token->damage->drain thesis. Six of the deck's ETB payoffs (Impact Tremors, Purphoros, Corpse Knight, Witty Roastmaster, Warleader's Call, Mirkwood Bats) are exactly the class `model_combat` reads, so the clock it unlocks is a reading of this deck's actual output rather than a proxy. This is a PER-DECK flag, not a change to goldfish.py: `meta.model_version` does not move and no other deck's figures change. It DOES restate this deck's own baseline -- `mean_bodies_by_turn` switches from `bodies` to `creature_bodies` -- so goldfish_metrics.json and mana_analysis.json are regenerated in the same commit, and any A/B measures both arms under it.

_deaths_note: model_deaths DECLARED 2026-10-19, the pilot's call ("measure twice, cut once"): the death channel prices death-triggered draw and distance drain only on the deaths the model produces, and until now Edgar's were its own token sacrifices alone — about 0.6 by turn eight — so Morbid Opportunist, Vraan and Vein Ripper on mean-v1 read as near nothing while the table kills Edgar's creatures at 0.86 a turn. A MEASURED rate, never authored: the figure is read off the named Forge run as goblin-storm's is (`source`). The run is on V3 (7be137d0) and the deck is V4; the rate is a property of the table and the deck's shape (tokens into blockers and wipes), re-read when a run on the current list exists. Expect the champion's board and damage figures to FALL under it — the instrument getting less wrong, the 2026-09-28 regen's lesson.
_v210_note: REPAIRED 2026-10-20 after the mean-v2 merge (v2.1.0), by oracle text: fifteen cut names removed from every group; Vraan and Vein Ripper placed as death-drains; Enduring Tenacity as a gain-to-loss half of the infinite (stack 012); Captivating and Cordial as lords; the two Talismans and Urza's Incubator as ramp; Morbid Opportunist and Clavileño as draw engines; Charismatic Conqueror, Cordial, Bloodghast, Vraan and Tithe Drinker as castable Vampires (Tithe Drinker had been missing since v2.0.0); Phyrexian Tower as a free sacrifice outlet. Anowon, Drana and Linvala and Exotic Orchard sit in no group: the goldfish has no opponents to tax, lock or edict, and cannot rank lands.
